About This Hub

Built to Connect Us All

The locksmith trade has always had the people. What it's been missing is the place — a real community where everyone in this industry can come together, talk, learn, and grow.

Built by the community

Lee Odess

Founder, The Access Control Collective (TACC)

Lee has spent years building one of the most respected communities in the physical security industry. When he saw an opportunity to extend that same energy into the locksmith trade, he didn't hesitate. This hub is that bridge.

Dave O'Toole

International Director, ALOA · President, European Locksmith Federation

Dave represents locksmiths on both sides of the Atlantic. He knew the trade needed this — a space where professionals across every region could finally find each other. He helped make it happen.

Together, they brought their worlds together. Built in partnership with ALOA (Associated Locksmiths of America) and ELF (European Locksmith Federation).

Learn More About This Partnership →
ALOA → ELF → TACC →

"Electronic locking and digital access are reshaping our industry and creating both challenges and opportunities for locksmiths. Through this partnership, our members gain access to a global community, practical insight, and meaningful discussion that supports real skills development and long term business growth."

Dave O'Toole — International Director, ALOA & European Locksmith Federation
Get Connected

Community Channels

Two dedicated community spaces built for electronic locksmiths — one for ALOA & ELF members, one open to everyone. Both hosted on our digital community platform.

Join the Electronic Locksmith Community

Hover to learn more ↓

You don't need a membership to join. Open to any locksmith or security professional who wants to be part of the conversation.
